sn12.23:2.1: Elsewhere _saupanisa_ is used of the seven path factors as “vital conditions” for right immersion ([sn45.28:1.2](), [mn117:2.1]()). | It is not clear if _upanisa_ is the same as the Sanskrit _upaniṣad_, which has the sense “hidden connections”, referring to esoteric teachings that explained the secret links between things (Śatapatha Brāhmaṇa 10.4.5.1, We find it in the sense “sitting close” ([an3.67:6.7]()).
